title: 178. MENTAL HEALTH HOT TAKES: Teen Mental Health, Therapeutic Boarding School, Exposure Therapy, & More!
description_html:
In this week's solo episode, I discuss my ultimate mental health hot takes! I give my most honest takes on what works and what doesn't when it comes to your mental health and share some of my favorite mental health tips I've learned throughout my recovery. I give my hot takes on topics such as:

+ Mental health progression & regression

+ What you should do when your mental health ISN'T struggling

+ Why positive psychology is absolutely necessary

+ Teens going to each other for mental health advice

+ Why EVERYONE should do exposure therapy

+ Why there are no reputable therapeutic boarding schools for teens

+ so much more!

summary: sadie shares her personal mental health hot takes from her own recovery journey. she covers why your mental health is never static—if you're not progressing, you're regressing—and why building skills before you're in crisis matters. she explains the difference between reducing suffering and actually building a life worth living, drawing on positive psychology research. she also discusses why teens shouldn't lean on other teens for mental health support, why everyone should practice exposure therapy for everyday anxieties, and why there are no truly reputable long-term therapeutic boarding schools (they isolate teens from family, which contradicts what research says helps).
